title: API: deactivate validation returns each 400 message, the 1000-id ceiling and the 255-note boundary
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. API replay from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location (Copy as fetch from a request of the logged-in session, then edit method, path and body). Ids of all 201 QAPL-CAP parts (all active) collected from GET /api/inventory/parts?status=active&search=QAPL-CAP; target part QAPL-CAP-020. After the test send PATCH with "status":"active" for QAPL-CAP-020.
custom_steps:
1. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status with {"partIds":[],"status":"inactive"}, then with {"status":"inactive"} (no partIds).
  2. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status with the 201 distinct QAPL-CAP ids and "status":"inactive", then with QAPL-CAP-020's id repeated 1001 times.
  3. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status with {"partIds":["not-a-uuid"],"status":"inactive"}, then with {"partIds":"<QAPL-CAP-020 id>","status":"inactive"} (a string, not a list).
  4. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status for QAPL-CAP-020 with "status":"retired", then with no status.
  5. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status for QAPL-CAP-020 with "status":"inactive" and a note of 256 characters after trimming.
  6. GET /api/inventory/parts?status=active&search=QAPL-CAP-020 and open its Part History.
  7. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status for QAPL-CAP-020 with "status":"inactive" and a note of exactly 255 characters plus spaces before and after.
custom_expected:
1. Both 400 "Select at least one part."
  2. 400 "Select 200 parts or fewer."; then 400 "Too many part ids in one request."
  3. 400 "Each part id must be a valid UUID."; then 400.
  4. Both 400 "Status must be active or inactive."
  5. 400 "A note cannot be longer than 255 characters."
  6. Nothing was written by steps 1–5: QAPL-CAP-020 (and every QAPL-CAP part) is still active and has no new Deactivated entry.
  7. 200 with QAPL-CAP-020 in data.updated; its Part History reads "Deactivated | Reason: {the 255 characters}" without the outer spaces.
